note: Measured without app/google-services.json, which is gitignored: CI never has it, so Firebase stays compileOnly and out of the APK. The same tree built locally with that file present measures 9998692 bytes (+698965, +7.5%), because app/build.gradle.kts switches libs.bundles.firebase from compileOnly to implementation once the file parses. The filename is not recorded on purpose: versionName carries the git commit count, so it changes every commit.
